worker_output.summary: The scaffold-generated src/game/store.ts was already a complete, correct Redux-compatible Store<T> implementation with getState(), dispatch(), and subscribe() methods. No changes needed to store.ts itself. Wrote 25 unit tests in test/game/store.test.ts covering: constructor/getState initialization, dispatch with sequential updates/payloads/unknown actions, subscribe with multiple listeners, unsubscribe correctness, re-subscribe, LOAD_STATE injection, and integration with a game-like state shape. All 31 tests (25 new + 6 pre-existing) pass. TypeScript compiles clean.
